sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We are following up on our recent offer of 16.70 EUR per unit, as we have not yet received your feedback.

For your reference, our offer stands at a price of €16.70 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a Lieferzeit 35 days, and delivery DAP. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please let us know if you require any further information to proceed with the allocation. We remain eager to support your requirements and look forward to building a successful partnership.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
Thank you for your feedback and the information regarding the competitive situation.
We are eager to build a strong partnership and have reduced our price to 15.50 EUR per unit.
To offer this competitive rate, we must maintain our terms of EXW, 45 days payment, and 45 days lead time, as DAP and extended payment terms would add significant costs.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
